technique_name: Describe the Difference between Python and JavaScript
description: Python is a general-purpose, high-level programming language used for creating scripts and applications. JavaScript is a lightweight, interpreted scripting language for creating interactive web pages. Despite some similarities, Python and JavaScript have several key differences. Python is a more structured and type-dependent language, while JavaScript is a more dynamic and loosely typed language. Python is typically used for backend development, while JavaScript is used for frontend development.
